You will combine deep technical expertise in Java backend engineering, React frontend development, and AI / GenAI integration acting as the technical face of the organisation with clients. This is a rare combination of hands-on engineering excellence and strong client engagement skills you will write production code, design solutions, and build trusted technical relationships with client engineering teams simultaneously.
